sunny-morning-sleep-in:afterBurst.label: After her Burst hits
sunny-morning-sleep-in:afterBurst.reason: It lasts 30 seconds after her Elemental Burst hits, longer than a Burst takes to come back, so it is up between her Bursts; a wielder whose Burst deals no damage, such as Nahida, never starts it and can switch it off.

sunny-morning-sleep-in:afterSkill.label: After her Skill hits
sunny-morning-sleep-in:afterSkill.reason: It lasts 9 seconds after her Skill hits, which covers only part of her attacks.

sunny-morning-sleep-in:swirl.label: After a Swirl
sunny-morning-sleep-in:swirl.reason: It needs a Swirl reaction, which depends on the elements of the team.
